questions.stem: What is the difference between rod cells and cone cells in the retina?

options.text: Rod cells detect colour while cone cells detect light intensity
Rod cells are sensitive to dim light while cone cells detect colour
Rod cells are found in the fovea while cone cells are around the edges
Rod cells only work in bright light while cone cells work in all conditions

questions.explanation: Rod cells are very sensitive and work well in dim light but only detect black and white. Cone cells require bright light and are responsible for detecting colour. Cones are concentrated in the fovea.
